title: Six equivalent conditions for dominance of a morphism between integral schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six equivalent conditions for a morphism of integral schemes to be dominant: dominance, hitting the generic point, injectivity of the coordinate ring map for some, respectively all, pairs of nonempty affine charts, and injectivity of the local ring map at some, respectively all, points (statement lines 1624-1642). The counted proof reduces the whole cycle to one observation made twice: on an integral scheme the generic point corresponds to the zero ideal, so dominance becomes injectivity of the ring map, and the same reading of the zero ideal works for local rings because the spectrum of a local ring corresponds to the points specializing to the given point (proof lines 1644-1666). It is H2: the proof is a clean reduction carried out in the counted span, with no independent research-level content.
